children: Eagers Automotive's agreement to buy a multi-franchise dealership group in California alongside CanadaOne Auto founder Pat Priestner is an interesting strategic move, UBS says. Eagers said the deal gives it a beachhead into the U.S. market via a high-volume Toyota dealership. Analyst Tim Plumbe says the Toyota brand is appealing and both investors have a strong record with the automaker. "We see scope for further acquisition opportunities," UBS says. It estimates the deal could boost Eagers's EPS by 0.9%-1.2%, although this would be influenced by what the investors are paying for land. UBS had a neutral call on Eagers prior to the U.S. deal announcement. Eagers is up 0.1% at A$14.60. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
